name: pytest-queryguard
description: Shows the N+1 queries that pytest-queryguard found in the last test run on their lines: SQL, count and fix on hover.

commands.title: Run pytest on the Test at the Cursor
Run pytest on the Whole Project

queryguard.reportFile.markdownDescription: The report the findings are read from, relative to `#queryguard.pytestDirectory#`: a `--queryguard-json` file, or a `--queryguard-sarif` file when it ends in `.sarif`. The run commands write it, and the extension reloads it whenever it changes.

queryguard.pytestDirectory.markdownDescription: The directory pytest runs in, relative to the workspace folder (empty: the folder itself). The files named in the report are looked up relative to it, so it should be pytest's rootdir: the directory of your `pytest.ini` or `pyproject.toml`.

queryguard.pythonPath.markdownDescription: The Python that runs `python -m pytest`. Empty: the interpreter selected in the Python extension, or `python3` (`python` on Windows) without it.

queryguard.pytestArgs.markdownDescription: More arguments for pytest, put before the file or test, e.g. `["-p", "no:randomly"]`.

queryguard.showBaselined.markdownDescription: Also mark the findings that the baseline accepts (as hints). Only a `--queryguard-json` report lists them.
